reasoning: n = a² + b² is representable iff every prime p ≡ 3 (mod 4) appears to an even power in n (Fermat/Euler two-squares theorem). I counted such n in [1, 2026] by direct enumeration of all sums a²+b² ≤ 2026 (a,b ≥ 0, dedup) and cross-checked with the prime-factorization criterion; both give 626. Cumulative intermediate totals of representable n: up to 100: 43; up to 500: 177; up to 1000: 330; up to 1500: 476; up to 2000: 619; up to 2026: 626 (the seven representable n in 2001..2026 are 2005, 2009, 2010, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2025).
prompt:
How many integers n with 1 ≤ n ≤ 2026 can be written as a² + b² for integers a, b ≥ 0?
